title: 因果审计：基于目标感知因果链构建的显式可审计图推理
summary: 提出一种显式可审计的因果推理框架，通过目标感知因果图构建和路径级因果证据聚合，实现超越表面相关性的因果推理，在三个基准上优于现有LLM方法。
summary_en: Proposes an explicit and auditable causal reasoning framework that constructs target-aware causal graphs and aggregates path-level evidence, outperforming existing LLM methods on three benchmarks for intervention-based QA.
